drhp.business: Gujarat Raffia Industries operates in a single segment making tarpaulin, fabric and HDPE/PP woven sacks. Its products serve the fertilizer and agriculture sectors and food-grain packaging by government agencies, with an export push into markets benefiting from relaxation of mandatory jute packaging norms.
drhp.expansion: The Company expects completion of plant capacity expansions by year-end 2025-26, which along with its presence in the fertilizer and agriculture sectors and growth in food-grain packaging by government agencies, is expected to drive domestic demand for tarpaulin, fabric and sacks.

Metal rolls are the consumable working element of rolling mills — cast or forged in alloy steel, spheroidal graphite iron, high-chrome iron, adamite, graphite steel, indefinite-chill or tungsten carbide — which shape billets, blooms and slabs into finished long and flat steel; because they wear continuously, they are replaced on average every 5-10 weeks, making demand a consumable annuity that CRISIL describes as 'perfectly and …
